incidents.summary: The FCA censured Quilter-owned Lighthouse for unsuitable pension-transfer advice given between April 2015 and April 2019, for which Quilter paid approximately £23.17 million in redress.

sources.title: FCA praises Quilter over BSPS
sources.quote: The watchdog censured Lighthouse for unsuitable advice given between 1 April 2015 and 30 April 2019.

sources.title: FCA censures Lighthouse Advisory Services Limited for serious failings in relation to the British Steel Pension Scheme and £23m paid out in redress | FCA
sources.quote: By 30 April 2023, Quilter had paid approximately £23.17 million in redress to put affected Lighthouse customers back in the financial position they would have been in were it not been for Lighthouse’s unsuitable advice.

sources.title: FCA censures Lighthouse Advisory Services Limited for serious failings in relation to the British Steel Pension Scheme and £23m paid out in redress | FCA
sources.quote: Quilter Financial Planning Limited (Quilter) acquired Lighthouse in June 2019, after the unsuitable advice.

incidents.summary: The Financial Ombudsman Service upheld a decision against Quilter Financial Services after finding that an appointed representative gave a client unsuitable advice.

sources.title: Fos finds Quilter AR gave ‘unsuitable advice’ to client - FTAdviser
sources.quote: The Financial Ombudsman Service has upheld a decision against Quilter Financial Services after finding one of its appointed representatives gave unsuitable advice.

sources.title: Fos finds Quilter AR gave ‘unsuitable advice’ to client - FTAdviser
sources.quote: The ombudsman decided to uphold Mrs B’s complaint due to her misclassification as a moderate investor

positives: The FCA praised Quilter for taking responsibility for Lighthouse’s pre-acquisition unsuitable advice and improving its inadequate controls.
Quilter introduced a discretionary portfolio service strategy that excludes fossil fuels.
Quilter adopted the Halo Code to protect freedom to wear afro-hairstyles without restriction or judgment.
